about_the_game:
In this action-roguelike, enter a post-apocalyptic world run by AI. While trying to get her TV repaired, Amy finds herself in a strange location where everything is trying to kill her, even the trash cans. Team up with the mischievous and mysterious HAZEL, some guy named Scott, and many more robots as you gain equipment and battle your way through an ever-shifting corporate tower.

Helping you along your way is HAZEL, an only slightly psychotic AI weapon who can be upgraded with a variety of powers. Whether you prefer sniping from a distance, harnessing clever physics, or just bathing your enemies in a spray of glowing death, Hazel's got you covered.

Not all robots are out to get you. Some of them are quite friendly! As you adventure, you'll meet a variety of helpful bots who will give you new abilities or enhancements. Each offers a different bonus, and you can choose which ones to visit as you progress. Will you visit Dorian, do "Bizness" with Bizmo, or accept a suspicious item from Hackley?

The robots aren't going down without a fight, or several. Every room brings a unique blend of bullet-hell combat and action-packed platforming. Use the room layouts to your advantage, climbing to safety from ground robots or hiding from flying bots under low platforms. But watch out for room hazards!

FEATURES

  • Fast-paced, side-scrolling bullet hell action across 50+ rooms.

  • Lots of sci-fi and pop culture easter eggs.

  • Equip a variety of fun weapons to take on a variety of silly challenges that are as silly as they are challenging.

  • You can Bizness when the time is right.

  • If you've made it this far, why are you still reading? Go wishlist the game!

  • Plenty of memorable NPCs to discover and befriend.

short_description: AI has possessed everything. Toasters, telephones, and trash cans have come alive and want you dead. Fight back with a bizarre array of weapons, from bouncy balls to banana guns. Battle through deadly arenas and make strange allies in this action roguelike, as you uncover an apocalyptic conspiracy.
